content: Jisos nu keman kè lɛɛshi bibefɛ bisɛɛbeene

Boom bem, me nsaaŋke fiɛɛ fin ɛ̂ ben wvu lɛ fo ben ke enɛ ege kebefɛ kɛ. Geenɛn, ɛ́ wee nɛlo ɛ ge kebefɛ, tu beene kɛŋke wee wvù kule can ɛ̂ Nyo' Ice fô beene le, ɛ wee wvun nu Jisos Klistu wvù nu wee wvu teytey.
Ɛ̀ nu wvú keman kè lɛɛshi bibefɛ bisɛɛbeene, ɛ keman kin yaa nu kɛ fô bibefɛ bisɛɛbeene le maaŋ kɛ, kí nu tɛn fô bi bonyii bocii le yî woŋ wvun e.
Ɛ́ beene gɛɛle bonci bo Nyo' le, ɛ́ fifin emum eduŋci ntay lɛ beene kee wvú.
Wee wvù duu lɛ wen kee Nyo', geenɛn yaa gɛɛle bonci bew kɛ, nu wee mbiay, ɛ kecɛɛy yaa nu yî ye le kɛ.
Geenɛn, wee wvù gɛɛle njeme we nu wvuwɛ wvù nu kecɛɛy wee wvù kooŋke Nyo' gɛne mɛɛse. Fiɛɛ fì nulo eduŋcɛ ntay ɛ́ wee sɛ kiɛɛ lɛ wen nu ɛ taashɛ bô Nyo' nu fin fì lɛ:
Ɛ́ wee duu lɛ wen nu sekecii yî Nyo' le tu wvú kɛŋke keeceè kɛ lɛŋlɛŋ ɛ̂ je yì Klistu to cee le.
Nci wvu fwɛ
Nsáa yɛm shém, kɛ nci wvù me ŋgomte keensaŋ fô ben e nu nci wvu fwɛ kɛ. Ɛ̀ nu nci wvu yvum wvù ben to kɛŋke ɛ kɛw foŋkɛw. Ɛ nci wvu yvum wvun nu saaka wvù ben to yuwɛɛ wase.

Geenɛn nci wvù me nsaaŋke ɛ̂ ben nu kɛ nci wvu fwɛ. Kecɛɛy ke nci wvun e to nu ɛ duŋcɛ yî Klistu le, ɛ no duŋci tɛn yî yene le. Nci wvudvu yen'yi fwɛ njefo kejiwɛ kaa wase gɛne, ɛ n'yuu wvu kecɛɛy ɛ kɛw wase ɛ no baa.
Ɛ́ wee duu lɛ wen nu ɛnte jo n'yuu bvuu bane waa bwee, tu wvú bɛɛ kɛ ɛnte jo kejiwɛ.
Wee wvù kooŋke waa bwee nu ɛ wvú nu sekecii ɛnte jo n'yuu ɛ fiɛɛ yaa nu yî ye le fì nulo ege ɛ́ wvú elɛne baytene kɛ.
Geenɛn, wee wvù bane waa bwee nu ɛ wvú nu ɛ̂ kejiwɛ le lɛne jó yaa kee fô wvú gɛne kɛ, njefo kejiwɛ kedvu nu ɛ ge wase wvú ɛ fefe.
Boom bem, me nsaaŋke fô ben e njefo bó nu ɛ lɛɛshɛ wase bibefɛ binɛn nje Klistu.

Bo'icɛm, me nsaaŋke fô ben e njefo ben kee wase wvú wvudvu wɛ wvù to nu foŋkɛw. Cubonyii, me nsaaŋke fô ben e njefo ben nu ɛ so wase wee kebefɛ wɛ. Boom bem, me nsaaŋke fô ben e njefo ben kee Nyo' Ice.
Bo'icɛm, me nsaaŋke fô ben e njefo ben kee wase wvú wvudvu wvù to nu foŋkɛw. Cubonyii, me nsaaŋke fô ben e njefo ben tɛmyi lo ɛ diɛw Nyo' nu sekecii yî yene le, ɛ ben ɛ so wase wee kebefɛ wɛ.
Me ɛ mum ɛ no nteete ben lɛ, fo ben ekooŋkè woŋ wvun kɛnɛɛ mwɛɛm mvu yî woŋ wvun e kɛ. Ɛ́ wee kooŋke woŋ wvun, wvú saa ekooŋke Nyo' Ice kɛ.

Ben ekeè lɛ mwɛɛm mvunciim ɛ̂ woŋ jan mvù nyam ye kɛŋke shiee yî dvu le bô mvù ɛjisɛ taale kooŋke, noo mvù bonyii bensee ye yî dvú le yî nshii wvun e, yaa nu mvù nɛn'yi fô Nyo' Ice le kɛ. Ɛ̀ nu mvu yî woŋ wvun e.
Woŋ wvun nu ke eka, ɛ́ mwɛɛm mvu yî woŋ wvun e mvù bonyii kɛŋke shiee yî dvú le eka tɛn. Geenɛn, wee wvù gee ɛ ɛ̀ nu fiɛɛ fì Nyo' shieele nu ke emɛy enu dvú sekecii.
Bonyii bo bvuban e bo Klistu le

Boom bem, kefew kin nu wase ke fokemɛse. No ben to yuwɛɛ lɛ wee bvuban Klistu nu ke eto, nu ɛ naa keseen nu ɛ bonyii bo bvuban e bo Klistu le ɛ to wase nteen. Ɛ̀ nɛɛ fiɛɛ fì ge beene ɛ mum ɛ kiɛɛ lɛ kin nu wase kefew ke fokemɛse.

Bonyii bodvu ban to buy ɛ̂ beene ɛntelɛŋ, geenɛn kɛ bó to nu bonyii bosɛɛbeene kɛ. Ɛ́ bó to nu bonyii bosɛɛbeene, tu bó to bee emɛy enu beene ɛ bó. Nonɛn ɛ bó mum buy wvu lɛ fí eduŋcɛ ɛndan lɛ kɛ bó nu bonyii bosɛɛbeene kɛ.
Ben nu finɛn ɛ wvú wvù ɛ̀ nu Wvú wvù Yuule ɛ yefe
wase ben, ben ɛ no kee mwɛɛm mvu kecɛɛy.
Kɛ me nsaaŋke fô ben e ɛ ɛ̀ nu njefo ben maa kecɛɛy kɛ. Me nsaaŋke njefo ben kee kecɛɛy, ɛ ben kee tɛn lɛ kɛ ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ mbiay ebuy ɛnte jo kecɛɛy kɛ.
Wee mbiay nu wvù la? Kɛ ɛ̀ nu wvuwɛ wvù tune lɛ kɛ Jisos nu Mboyse wvù Nyo' to kawɛɛ le? Wee wvù tune Nyo' Ice bô Waa we nu wvuwɛ wvù nu wee bvuban Klistu.
Kɛ wee wvù tune Wan kɛŋke kentaashɛ bô Icee Wan wvudvu kɛ. Wee wvù jemyi bô diuw we lɛ wen nu ɛ bee Wan e, nu wvù kɛŋke kentaashɛ bô Icee Wan tɛn.
Ben egɛɛ fiɛɛ fì ben to yuwɛɛ foŋkɛw ɛ́ fí enu sekecii yî yene le. Ɛ́ ben gɛke fiɛɛ fì ben to yuwɛɛ foŋkɛw fí ɛ no nu sekecii yî yene le, ɛ́ ben tɛn emum enu sekecii yî Waa Nyo' bô Ice le.
Ɛ fiɛɛ fì Klistu nu ɛ kaw beene dvú nu nshii wvù mɛy lo.
Me nsaaŋke mwɛɛm mvun fô ben e ɛ ɛ̀ nu ɛkumɛ bonyii bò gomte keelɛɛle ben.

Geenɛn n'yefe wvù ben to kɛŋkɛɛ ɛ̂ Klistu nu sekecii yî yene le, ɛ ben yaa bvuu shieele lo wee mvu wvù ebvuu eyɛɛyi ben kɛ. No n'yefe we wvun yɛɛyi wase ben ɛkumɛ mwɛɛm mvunciim, ɛ n'yefe wvudvu nu wvu kecɛɛy, sɛ ɛ̀ nu wvu mbiay, ben emum enù sekecii yî Klistu le kɛ lɛŋlɛŋ no n'yefe wvun nu ɛ yɛɛyi ben.
Boom bem, ben emum emɛy enù sekecii yî ye le wvu lɛ seke wvú ɛ ke ɛ buynɛn, ɛ́ beene ekɛŋke fitele keeyɛn wvú le ɛfey keeke enyiimɛn lo ɛnte jo ken'wuumɛn.
Ɛ́ ben kee lo lɛ wvú nu wee wvù gee mwɛɛm teytey, tu ben kɛŋke keekeè tɛn lɛ wee tfuu wvù gee fiɛɛ fi teytey nu ɛ ɛ̀ nu mboo we.

footnotes.text: N'yefe wvun nu Keyoy ke Yuule kè bó nu ɛ nya ɛ̂ bó.
